decisions.reason: Turnaround management software is core to the firm's data-driven airside strategy and has had its own page in both years, so it is a stable part of the portfolio.
The apron connectivity module was promoted from a mention to its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment and fit with the firm's integrated apron offering.
Billing software sits further from the firm's hardware core, but it gained its own page in 2024 and supports the firm's expanding software and service revenue.
Equipment monitoring links directly to the firm's installed equipment base and maintenance services, and its 2024 promotion to its own page shows rising emphasis.
